scope: P1 first vertical slice: one approved observation creates a cited weekly assessment draft and a family bulletin draft in one atomic local transaction.

acceptance.claim: The two records commit atomically, stale sources are rejected and repeated clicks do not create duplicates.
The complete flow works at 320 px without horizontal overflow and survives backup export and restore.
Source and uncertainty are disclosed, the raw observation is preserved and cloud success is not simulated during local fallback.

open_scope: DeepSeek-generated child-specific text remains behind a separate privacy-safe redaction and teacher-review gate.
Official weekly plan evaluation continues to require completed day closures and confirmed curriculum links.
